attributes.name: Dagger Pistol +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6+1; you may additionally bury this card to add another 1d8. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on 1, shuffle this card into your deck.

On your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add 1d4.
